definition.@EndUserText.label: View 1
definition.@DataWarehouse.sqlEditor.query:
SELECT 
    b."BATCH_ID",
    CURRENT_UTCTIMESTAMP () AS "LOAD_TIMESTAMP",
    'HIST_RAW' AS "SOURCE_SYSTEM",
    o."SOURCE_FILE",
    "d"."BUKRS","d"."BELNR","d"."GJAHR","d"."BUZEI","d"."BUZID","d"."AUGDT","d"."AUGCP","d"."AUGBL","d"."BSCHL","d"."KOART","d"."UMSKZ","d"."UMSKS","d"."ZUMSK","d"."SHKZG","d"."GSBER","d"."PARGB","d"."MWSKZ","d"."QSSKZ","d"."DMBTR","d"."WRBTR","d"."KZBTR","d"."PSWBT","d"."PSWSL","d"."VALUT","d"."ZUONR","d"."SGTXT","d"."ZINKZ","d"."VBUND","d"."BEWAR","d"."KOKRS","d"."KOSTL",COALESCE(CAST(d.SAKNR AS VARCHAR(100)), '') as "SAKNR","d"."HKCONT","d"."KUNNR","d"."LIFNR","d"."MWSK1","d"."DMBT1","d"."WRBT1","d"."MWSK2","d"."DMBT2","d"."WRBT2","d"."MWSK3","d"."DMBT3","d"."WRBT3","d"."REBZG","d"."REBZJ","d"."REBZZ","d"."REBZT","d"."ZOLLT","d"."ZOLLD","d"."LZBKZ","d"."LANDL","d"."DIEKZ","d"."SAMNR","d"."ABPER","d"."VRSKZ","d"."VRSDT","d"."DISBN","d"."DISBJ","d"."DISBZ","d"."WVERW","d"."ANFBN","d"."ANFBJ","d"."ANFBU","d"."ANFAE","d"."BLNBT","d"."BLNKZ","d"."BLNPZ","d"."MSCHL","d"."MANSP","d"."MADAT","d"."MANST","d"."MABER","d"."ESRNR","d"."ESRRE","d"."ESRPZ","d"."DMBE2","d"."DMBE3","d"."DMB21","d"."DMB22","d"."DMB23","d"."DMB31","d"."DMB32","d"."DMB33","d"."MWST2","d"."MWST3","d"."NAVH2","d"."NAVH3","d"."SKNT2","d"."SKNT3","d"."BDIF3","d"."RDIF3"
FROM "1_INBOUND_HIST_RAW.1LT_BSEG_HIST_RAW" d
	CROSS JOIN "2SV_ACTIVE_BATCH_HIST_RAW_01" b
	JOIN "2LT_CTRL_LOAD_OBJECT_01" o 
	    ON o."BATCH_ID" = b."BATCH_ID" 
	        AND o."SOURCE_SYSTEM" = 'HIST_RAW' 
	        AND o."OBJECT_NAME" = 'BSEG'
